duplicates risk inconsistent downstream matching.","source_ids":["e8:148:231","e8:231:274","e9:0:83"]},{"field":"data.education[0].graduation_year","issue":"Year '2011' is correctly sourced, but start_year unresolved while an MBA alongside a 2009 bachelor's implies a plausible start year; No date invention detected.","source_ids":["e13:0:65","e22:0:75"]},{"field":"data.total_experience_years","issue":"Summary states '4+ years in requirements and Agile delivery, built on 8+ years in financial operations' — total_experience_years is null; combined tenure (~12+ years) is derivable but not asserted, so no invented value. Noting only that the field is unresolved while summary provides a split figure.","source_ids":["e4:0:92"]},{"field":"data.experience[2].responsibilities","issue":"Last responsibility omits the source fragment '...corporate actions in' / 'collaboration with external vendors.' split ('Resolved data mismatches...corporate actions in' stored but 'collaboration with external vendors.' stored separately as its own bullet).","source_ids":["e39:0:81","e40:0:36"]},{"field":"data.professional_title","issue":"Title 'Senior Business Analyst | Financial Markets' matches source subtitle, fine; but summary claims BA experience '4+ years' while earliest BA role listed (Barclays Senior Reference Data Analyst, 2015) is not a BA title and BA-titled roles begin July 2019 — a 4+ year BA claim from 2019 is plausible (~4.5 yrs to Jan 2024), no invented value but flagged for consistency.","source_ids":["e0:18:61","e4:0:92","e22:0:75","e13:0:65"]}]}
